title: Advanced carbon-based rear electrodes for low-cost and efficient perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05462H, Review Article
Jingsheng He, Yu Bai, Zhixin Luo, Ran Ran, Wei Zhou, Wei Wang, Zongping Shao
This article reviews important advances in the design and fabrication of carbon-based rear electrodes for perovskite solar cells, aiming to present vital insights for the scalable production and widespread applications of this technology.
